ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; approximately 92% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 8% high-intensity (light grey/glare) across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity region across entire fluke. Distinct focal patches of medium-intensity grey (mottling) located in the upper distal quadrant of the right lobe and along the leading edge margins of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical bounding box of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels; notable high-amplitude 'peaks' present on the medial sections of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitted to the trailing edge, transitioning to a sharp upward convexity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse detection of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters located on the upper-right distal lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle detection of vertical-to-diagonal linear grey pixel disruptions on the medial right lobe, breaking the uniform dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentation on the distal margin of the left lobe tip, exceeding the frequency of standard edge serrations.
